blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Consunji-led Semirara Mining and Power Corp. (SMPC) is cutting its workforce anew amid significant seawater inflows threatening its Acacia coal mine operations. On Friday, it reported that the flow rate had already climbed to about 30,000 cubic meters per hour, massive inflows that could fill 12 Olympic-sized swimming pools every hour.
